csv_project_name: On-Call Full-Service City Engineering & Various Projects
csv_scope_of_work: The City is seeking Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified firms to provide full-service City Engineering services and on-call professional consulting services for a variety of federally funded, state-funded, Metro-funded, and other grant-funded projects, as well as locally funded Capital Improvement Projects (CIP), on an as-needed basis. The City seeks firm(s) to provide comprehensive, full-service City Engineering services. These services may include, but are not limited to: Acting as the City Engineer of record Project management for public works and CIP projects Construction management, resident engineering, and inspections Staff augmentation and technical support Plan checking and development review Transportation and traffic engineering Grant writing, grant administration, and reimbursement support Utility coordination (water, sewer, stormwater, power, telecom) Coordination with Metro, Caltrans, LA County, railroads, and other agencies Attendance at City Council, Planning Commission, Traffic Commission, and public meetings as necessary On-call technical advisory services to City staff
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Sanitation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning

- Framework-style on-call municipal engineering services without a defined structure or project.
